policy: fail-closed; exact ad-hoc station/EVSE tariff only; subscription, roaming, historical or sampled prices are not generalized

cpos.reason: NürnbergMesse officially documents more than 200 charging points and confirms ad-hoc activation by QR/NFC/web address through the Ativo backend, where the applicable tariff is displayed. The public current page does not expose the current numeric Ativo tariff. A 2022 NürnbergMesse PDF gave 0.3125 EUR/kWh + 1.25 EUR start fee, but it is historical and is not promoted to 2026.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve the current Ativo public checkout payload for each canonical DEDEP EVSE and capture its displayed tariff; verify whether both canonical sites share the same current contract.

cpos.reason: Current station-level/AFIR-derived discovery data reports 0.53 EUR/kWh AC and 0.74 EUR/kWh HPC for Comfortcharge, but only 11.3% price coverage is reported and no primary exhaustive Comfortcharge tariff contract was found. These sampled values therefore cannot be generalized.
cpos.neededToComplete: Enumerate DECCH EVSEs through AFIR/Mobilithek or public direct-payment payloads and attach exact per-EVSE prices, including blocking components; alternatively obtain a current primary Comfortcharge ad-hoc tariff proving network-wide scope.

cpos.reason: EWV officially confirms public ad-hoc charging by QR code at its stations. Its published card tariffs are 0.54 EUR/kWh AC and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC for the BASIS product, with 0.05 EUR/min from minute 241 AC / 91 DC during 09:00-21:00 capped at 20 EUR, but those values are explicitly EWV LADEKARTE product prices and are not assumed to equal ad-hoc QR pricing.
cpos.neededToComplete: Capture the current QR/direct-payment tariff shown for canonical DEEWV EVSEs and prove whether it is homogeneous; keep EWV card/subscription prices separate.

cpos.alias: ALDI Nord Deutschland Stiftung & Co. KG
cpos.reason: Current direct-payment observations for ALDI Nord are not uniform enough to infer a network rule from branding alone: a verified 150 kW site in Herbern is 0.44 EUR/kWh while a ladenetz-associated ALDI Nord site in Reinbek is 0.62 EUR/kWh. No current ALDI Nord primary page establishing one exhaustive national ad-hoc tariff matrix was found. Third-party claims resembling ALDI Süd's 0.29/0.44/0.47 matrix are not treated as authoritative for ALDI Nord.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve each DEALN EVSE/site to its actual charging backend/operator and capture the public QR/card tariff, or obtain a current ALDI Nord primary tariff policy explicitly covering the canonical network.
